title: Durable http node loose ends after #33594: HttpConfigSchema.method jsdoc, fallback body/Content-Type parity, explicit-method pin
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwhJBt274G7zk78A5a

Loose ends of #33487, left after PR #33594 merged (review#2 PASS record 6888595183, non-blocking nits). p3, one card for all three.

- **N1 (doc).** `HttpConfigSchema.method` jsdoc in `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` (~l.1097–1099) still quotes the removed code (`cfg.method ?? 'POST'` on the durable arm, `cfg.method ?? 'GET'` inline). Its meaning holds; the quoted code no longer exists.
- **N2.** The #33594 changeset says the no-outbox fallback sends "the same body and signature the outbox would deliver". That holds for object bodies only: for a bodyless node the outbox sends and signs `'{}'` while the fallback sends no body and signs `''`; a string body is sent verbatim by the outbox but JSON-encoded by the fallback; the fallback sends no `Content-Type: application/json` (which `sendOnce` sets). Either align `sendInline` with `deliveryBody`/`sendOnce`, or correct the wording where it is restated.
- **N3 (test).** Pin that an explicit `method` wins on the durable no-outbox fallback (e.g. `durable: true, method: 'GET'` or `'PUT'` with no outbox); the changeset names `method: 'GET'` as the opt-out.

Area: A5 (service-automation). Resume-from: main after #33594.
